name: team-field
summary: Players' positions, distance and heat maps per team, ball possession and estimated passes and turnovers of a team sport (football, basketball, futsal, handball, hockey, volleyball).

hardware.camera: a fixed wide camera (broadcast cuts and replays are not handled); --court maps positions to metres
hardware.compute: a detector, a tracker and a team split; Roboflow's team split also runs SigLIP in its own environment

sota.summary: RF-DETR + Roboflow trackers BoT-SORT + colour team split (no model); post fits the teams over 30 s

roboflow.summary: Roboflow Sports' combination: RF-DETR, trackers ByteTrack, SigLIP embeddings + k-means team split (Roboflow reduces with UMAP, here PCA)

ultralytics.summary: Ultralytics' combination: YOLO26 with its BoT-SORT tracker (COCO weights), colour team split

limits: estimated possession and passes, never official statistics; the ball is often hidden by players (hidden_ms keeps the holder); team letters A/B are arbitrary; referees and goalkeepers join the nearer team unless teams is 3; basketball shots, offsides and in/out are not judged
measured: 2026-11-28, SportsMOT example (3 clips), GCP T4, player tracks only: post MOTA / IDF1 football 0.83 / 0.72 (roboflow), 0.80 / 0.67 (sota), 0.79 / 0.71 (ultralytics); basketball 0.62 / 0.52 best (roboflow); volleyball 0.35 / 0.55 best (roboflow); realtime lower with dropped frames. Possession and passes not measured. docs/measurements/sports-2026-11-28.md
